note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative: the contract, the clause lines and the liability categories are generic placeholders, never real contract text. 'Category included' and 'exclusion to be reviewed' are supplied statuses of equal weight (● and ◆ of the same area, colour and stroke); the contour only shows the supplied delimitation. No doctrine on limitation or exclusion clauses is stated: no enforceability, validity or effect, no cap or amount, no outcome; the tile to be reviewed stays neutral and fully drawn. Brief customizable fields not exposed (coordinator decision BRIEF CUSTOMIZABLE FIELDS, SESSION_HANDOFF 2026-10-05): schedules, definitions, priorities (the categories carry their own supplied status and clause line), actorLabels (the actors are two unnamed hands), objectLabels (the props carry no names; the category sheet heading is the sheetLabel field).
